title: SWE Assistant: A Curated Collection of Claude AI Skills for Software Engineers
description:
A curated collection of Claude AI skills for software engineers, organized by recurring engineering situations and informed by established engineering literature. Each skill is a Markdown document with YAML frontmatter (Anthropic skills format) that surfaces coaching prompts — checklists, frames, and questions — drawn from sources such as The Missing Readme (Riccomini & Ryaboy), Working Effectively with Legacy Code (Feathers), A Philosophy of Software Design (Ousterhout), Designing Data-Intensive Applications (Kleppmann), and the Agile Manifesto.

The skills are designed to prompt practitioner thinking rather than replace it, supporting the climb through Broadwell's stages of competence in early- and mid-career software engineering. Intended for students, junior engineers, educators, and curriculum designers.
